text:
ana: We need a crisp surface for fallthroughs on latency-tier routes. Two immediate problems: (1) clients need a deterministic machine-readable signal when they didn't get exactly what they asked for, and (2) ops/finance need unambiguous billing semantics.
ryan: Agreed. Concrete proposal: response meta should include `served_model`, `requested_model`, `fallthrough_reason` (enum), and `billing_model`. Keep reasons small and stable: [\"compat_mismatch\", \"region_unavailable\", \"capacity_preempt\", \"quality_degradation\"].
kai: Add `kv_cache_key_changed: true/false` when fallback invalidates cache affinity. That lets callers choose to re-prime or accept a cache miss.
marta: On billing: default should be to bill at served_model rate. Finance prefers that since cheaper variants reduce cost and that's fair. But offer a tenant opt-in `bill_at_requested` flag for contracts where customer insists on requested-model billing. We'll need legal signoff.
nana (ana): Here's a draft metadata shape (for SDKs to parse):
```
meta: {
  version: "v2",
  requested_model: "gptx-8f",
  served_model: "gptx-8q",
  fallthrough_reason: "region_unavailable",
  billing_model: "gptx-8q",
  kv_cache_key_changed: "true",
  quality_score: "0.92"
}
```
ryan: Important: bump the API `meta` version to v2 so older SDKs ignore the new fields. Don't break clients by sending new top-level fields.
kai: Implementation detail: evaluator must run single-pass with `max_fallthrough_hops=2` and record the chain in telemetry, but only expose the terminal `served_model` to clients. We can expose an optional `fallthrough_chain` only when `meta.version==v2` and tenant feature flag is on.
marta: Migration: 1) Simulate on 7d of production traces and log hypothetical fallthroughs, 2) Canary where we surface `meta` but use header `X-Fallthrough-Logged-Only: true` so we don't change serving behavior yet, 3) Enable actual fallthroughs with tenant opt-in, 4) full rollout.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary window requested for shard eu-central-1 on 2026-04-09T14:00Z - notify on-call.
nana (ana): Tests: unit ordering tests for policy config, integration test that asserts `kv_cache_key_changed` when model variant changes, e2e sim to assert p95 latency delta and quality shift < 3%. Add a fuzz test for chained fallthrough prevention.
ryan: Telemetry: counters per `fallthrough_reason` and per `tenant`; histograms for latency delta and tokens extra-burned. Create dashboards and alert if fallback rate > 0.5% for any tenant in a 1h window.
kai: Runtime contract: evaluator returns either `Serve(model)` or `Fallthrough(reason, candidate)`; runtime applies candidate but MUST annotate meta. Keep fallthrough enums in proto/idl and keep numeric values stable.
marta: Ops note: when `billing_model != served_model` (i.e., bill_at_requested true), add `billing_override_reason` to meta. Finance needs daily report of overrides.
nana (ana): Edge-case discussion: what about KV cache chaos when region fallback picks a model with different embedding sharding? We should have a `cache_compat_level` in model manifests indicating whether cross-variant cache reuse is safe. If not safe, `kv_cache_key_changed=true`.
kai: I'll add `cache_compat_level` check into the evaluator and increment a counter when mismatch happens. Also add a guard that prevents fallback to a variant with `cache_compat_level==incompatible` unless tenant allows it.
ryan: SDKs: add helper `meta.is_fallthrough()` and `meta.get_quality_score()`; SDK major bump for v2. Document semantic guarantees: fallthrough metadata immutable once response returned.
marta: I'll open a finance/legal ticket for `bill_at_requested` contracts and scope the accounting change.
nana (ana): Next steps: I'll draft a short RFC (policy enums, meta schema, migration plan). Kai + Ryan will pair on sim harness changes and telemetry. Ops will schedule the canary. Backwards compat: default behavior remains unchanged unless tenant flags or we enable full rollout later.
ryan: Thanks. Small ask: ensure all enum names are snake_case and documented in the proto with examples.
kai: will do.
marta: filing follow-ups now.
nana (ana): RFC link when ready. :white_check_mark:
